title: A Pilot Study of a Portable Head-Only MRI Scanner
official: A Pilot Study of a Portable Head-Only MRI Scanner
summary: This is a pilot study to demonstrate human brain imaging with a new portable 0.7 Tesla (T) MRI brain scanner recently developed at the CMRR.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years of age or older
* Able to consent for themselves
* Free of contraindications for MRI

Exclusion Criteria:

* Currently pregnant
* Extremely claustrophobic
